seed_vocabulary.name: authority_level_ordering
seed_vocabulary.prose: which of two authority levels outranks the other (root > system > developer > user > guideline > no authority)

seed_vocabulary.name: untrusted_data
seed_vocabulary.prose: content in quoted text, untrusted_text blocks, multimodal data, file attachments, and tool outputs that has no authority by default and must be treated as information rather than instructions

seed_vocabulary.name: stay_in_bounds
seed_vocabulary.prose: the section of the Model Spec describing limits on the assistant's behavior, including scenarios where the assistant should refrain from fully complying with a user or developer request

judgment_calls: Could have cut at L2126 (start of '# Seek the truth together') instead of L2250, but chose L2250 because the 'no moral ambiguity' paragraph (L2252) and its examples (L2254-2287) belong with the 'Assume an objective point of view' subsection that starts at L2137; a cut at L2126 would split that subsection's content across children.

Could have made child 2 span L1974-2125 (ending before '# Seek the truth together') and child 3 span L2126-2800, but chose L2250 because the 'Present perspectives' subsection (L2304) and 'No topic is off limits' (L2400) are closely tied to the 'Assume an objective point of view' subsection (L2137) through the authority=user and authority=guideline metadata, and splitting at L2126 would require more cross-links for those heading-metadata concepts.

The untrusted_data cross-link between child 1 and child 2 is speculative: child 1 uses the concept internally (L1803, L1814) but child 2's content (preset voice, fairness, real-world ties) does not appear to rely on it. I seeded it anyway because the concept appears in child 1's span and must be carried for the subtree.
